note: Candidate Ted lines for T16 (lamp-room list) and T37 (SHIP_FAIL). Nothing here is in the game data or the voice plan until the creator picks. Run: python check_proposed_lines.py

lines.text: Up here, Isaac! Bring the burner. Mind the stairs, and don't you dare drop it!
lines.delivery: Shouted down the stairwell, hoarse, urgent.

lines.text: Burner in hand? Then climb! The lamp room, Isaac. She won't light herself.
lines.delivery: Shouted down the stairwell, gruff, coughing.

lines.text: Socket's open. Burner in, and be quick about it. Slowly, mind. She's old.
Well, don't just stand there gawping. The burner goes in the socket. Go on.
Seated. Come on, old girl. Come on. Let's see if she catches.
lines.delivery: Low, held breath, almost to himself.

lines.text: That's the burner home. Stand back, Isaac. Give her room to wake.
There's the light, and she's turning clear of the rocks. Hrmph. Not bad, Isaac. Not bad.
lines.delivery: Gruff, a cough covering real relief.

lines.text: She sees us! Look at her go, clear of the rocks. You did it, you money toff.
No. No, turn! Turn, you fool, the rocks! Oh, no.
lines.delivery: Shouted, then a breaking whisper on the last two words.

lines.text: She's too close. She's too close! Turn, damn you. Turn!
That ship...we didn't get the burner out in time...those poor souls on board...we've failed...FAILED!!
lines.delivery: Sorrowful, upset: grief breaking into anguish on the last word.
lines.plays: second, after the crash line, then silence and the Failed screen

lines.task: R05 / Exec Summary step 4: Ted names the ship at the boarding threshold
lines.text: A passenger ship? Now? It's not in the log! Without the beacon she'll find the rocks. Go, Isaac!
lines.delivery: Shocked, then barking; shouted from the dock path.

lines.task: R05 / Exec Summary step 4: Ted names the ship at the boarding threshold
lines.text: That's a passenger ship out there, and she's heading for my rocks. No beacon, no hope. Go!
